title: Design System: Zentanee
scope: Whole storefront (body.zh-body, prefix .zh-). The Control Room dashboard (zent-core.css, zent-dashboard.css) is out of scope. Maintenance: docs/homepage-tibeb-band.md.

display-hero.purpose: Homepage headline only. From 768px: clamp(44px, 5.6vw, 82px). Under html[lang=am]: Noto Sans Ethiopic, line-height 1.15, letter-spacing 0.

display.purpose: Every other page h1 (collection, cart, orders, account, FAQ, 404), max 22ch.

display-order-number.purpose: Order number on its own line inside the confirmation h1.

headline.purpose: Section titles and the search-empty recent heading.

headline-row.purpose: Collection and directory row names; each is a row, not a heading.

step-numeral.purpose: The 1 2 3 of the mechanism; 26px inside the product column.

title-xl.purpose: Summary, confirmation-block and empty-state headings; the ledger total value.

title-lead.purpose: Title and price of the 2x2 lead module in a weave rail.

title-lg.purpose: Restock and review-form headings, sticky-bar price, review average, prose blockquote.

title-value.purpose: Fee ruler and orders tally values, fit summary.

title.purpose: Step titles, fieldset legends, status titles, order numbers, wordmark (18px from 992px).

title-price.purpose: Module price, line totals, ledger values, brand names, FAQ summaries, account link rows.

title-sm.purpose: Address labels, product notes, quantity numeral.

body.purpose: Default copy; input text. Product and line titles are this size at weight 500.

body-sm.purpose: Alerts, status messages, table cells, footer links (500), checkbox labels, search field.

meta.purpose: Counts, toolbar summary, breadcrumbs, error messages (600), section links (600).

meta-sm.purpose: Ledger labels, help text, bylines, order dates, legal line, Remove button (600).

label.purpose: Uppercase form labels, table headers, footer language label, contact fact terms.

caption.purpose: Fee labels, brand under a product, step time line, sticky-bar size.

chip-size.purpose: Quick-add size chips under a product module; small button label.

nav.purpose: Primary nav, footer column titles, footer social (+0.08em), account link and cart button (+0.08em); all uppercase.

tag.purpose: Status flags: new, most wanted, sale, sold out, order status; uppercase.

motion.name: zh-ease
motion.purpose: The world ease: band weave-in, drawer slide, button transform, FAQ plus rotation, toast rise, link-row chevron.

motion.name: zh-weave
motion.value: clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0) -> inset(0), 1100ms zh-ease both, once
motion.purpose: Homepage hero band reveals left to right. Only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: colour-swap
motion.value: 160ms ease (buttons), 140ms ease (icon buttons, chips, cart, save)
motion.purpose: Ink/Paper inversion on hover and focus.

motion.name: toast
motion.purpose: Toast rises 12px and fades in above the tab bar.

motion.name: module-alt
motion.purpose: Alternate product image on module hover (hover: hover only).

motion.name: spinner
motion.purpose: 12px square ink spinner inside submitting buttons.

focus.name: focus-visible
focus.purpose: Global focus ring; also applied to label.zh-chip via input:focus-visible + .zh-chip and :has(input:focus-visible).

breakpoints.name: xs
breakpoints.notes: restock inline row becomes two columns

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.notes: band-h 72px, gap 20px, pad 24px; grid 3-col; ruler 4-col; tally 6-col; rail becomes 4-col dense grid with 2x2 lead; steps 3-col; timeline horizontal; footer 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; button padding 0 22px

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.notes: tab bar hidden, body padding-bottom 0; header search, account link, cart label and primary nav shown; grid 4-col; product page 7fr 5fr with sticky info; cart/confirm 7fr 5fr with sticky summary; sticky add-to-cart hidden

breakpoints.name: filters
breakpoints.notes: catalog filters open as a 260px ruled left column (zent.js sets details[open]); results grid 3-col

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.notes: band-h 88px; section padding 56px; hero column gap 72px; cart/confirm/account gutters 72px

bandTiles.full: 120x64 SVG tile; selvedge lines, chevrons, dashes, diamond chain; heights 56/72/88px; homepage hero and footer
bandTiles.thin: 24x12 SVG tile; two selvedge lines and alternating stripes; height 10px; header close, section dividers, under-tile beneath hero swatches and the product photo
tints: default (ink lead; indigo and green details)

components.name: Primary Button (selvedge)
components.description: Ink bar in Unbounded with a 6px indigo bottom edge. Hover inverts to Paper; the selvedge stays indigo.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 50px; padding: 0 18px; font-family: 'Unbounded', 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 12.5px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; line-height: 1.2; border: 2px solid #111111; background: #111111; color: #ffffff; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn--primary { border-bottom: 6px solid #1f3a93; } .ds-btn:hover, .ds-btn:focus-visible { background: #ffffff; color: #111111; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1f3a93; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Same bar, transparent; hover fills with ink.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 50px; padding: 0 18px; font-family: 'Unbounded', 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 12.5px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; line-height: 1.2; border: 2px solid #111111; background: transparent; color: #111111; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover, .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { background: #111111; color: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1f3a93; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: 44px square with a 2px ink border; menu, search, close, zoom. Inverts on hover.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-iconbtn" aria-label="Open menu"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M1 3h14M1 8h14M1 13h14" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-iconbtn { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; padding: 0; border: 2px solid #111111; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #111111; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-iconbtn:hover, .ds-iconbtn:focus-visible { background: #111111; color: #ffffff; } .ds-iconbtn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1f3a93; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Uppercase Archivo label over a 2px ink box on Paper; error is a 3px border and ink 600 text with the indigo underline. No red.
components.html:
We call this number to confirm before dispatch.

Enter your full name.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 18px; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; color: #111111; } .ds-field label { font: 600 12px/1.3 'Archivo', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 14px; border: 2px solid #111111; border-radius: 0; background: #ffffff; color: #111111; font: 400 15px/1.4 'Archivo', sans-serif; appearance: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #3d3a36; opacity: 1; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1f3a93; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-width: 3px; } .ds-help { margin: 0; font-size: 12.5px; color: #3d3a36; } .ds-error { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #111111; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 3px; text-decoration-color: #1f3a93; text-underline-offset: 0.14em; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Borderless field on a 2px ink bottom rule with a flat icon button; suggestions drop as a ruled Paper list.
components.html: <form class="ds-search" role="search"><input type="text" placeholder="Search products" aria-label="Search products"><button type="submit" aria-label="Search"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="7" cy="7" r="5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/><path d="M11 11l4 4" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/></svg></button></form>
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: stretch; width: 320px; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; } .ds-search input { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 8px; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid #111111; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #111111; font: 400 14px/1.4 'Archivo', sans-serif; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: #3d3a36; opacity: 1; } .ds-search input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1f3a93; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-search button { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; padding: 0; border: 2px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: #111111; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-search button:hover, .ds-search button:focus-visible { background: #111111; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Chip and Size Chip
components.description: 2px ink chips: filter chips at 34px, quick-add size chips at 30px, radio chips driven by a visually hidden input. Active inverts to ink.
components.css: .ds-chips, .ds-sizes { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin: 0 0 10px; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-sizes { gap: 4px; } .ds-chip, .ds-size { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 34px; height: 34px; padding: 0 10px; font: 600 12px/1 'Archivo', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.02em; border: 2px solid #111111; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #111111; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-size { height: 30px; padding: 0 8px; font-size: 11.5px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; } .ds-chip:hover, .ds-size:hover, .ds-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #111111; color: #ffffff; } .ds-size[disabled] { opacity: 0.35; cursor: not-allowed; text-decoration: line-through; } .ds-radios { display: flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-vh { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); } .ds-chip--radio { min-width: 48px; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; font-size: 13px; } .ds-vh:checked + .ds-chip--radio { background: #111111; color: #ffffff; } .ds-vh:focus-visible + .ds-chip--radio, .ds-chip:focus-visible, .ds-size:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1f3a93; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Tag
components.description: Uppercase flag on Paper with a 2px ink border; sale and sold-out invert to ink. No colour.
components.html: New Most wanted -20% Sold out
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 10px; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.2; background: #ffffff; color: #111111; border: 2px solid #111111; border-radius: 0; } .ds-tag--inverse { background: #111111; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Product Module
components.description: Photo on a Paper frame with 2px ink border, single tag, square save button, Archivo title, Unbounded tabular price, size chips. No card chrome, no shadow.
components.html:
Most wanted

Product title

Brand

1,999 ETB 2,400 ETB
components.css: .ds-module { position: relative; display: grid; gap: 10px; width: 220px; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; color: #111111; } .ds-module__media { position: relative; display: block; background: #ffffff; border: 2px solid #111111; } .ds-module__img { aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; background: #f2f1ee; } .ds-module__tag { position: absolute; top: 10px; left: -2px; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.2; background: #ffffff; color: #111111; border: 2px solid #111111; border-left: 0; } .ds-module__save { position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 8px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; padding: 0; border: 2px solid #111111; border-radius: 0; background: #ffffff; color: #111111; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-module__save:hover, .ds-module__save:focus-visible { background: #111111; color: #ffffff; } .ds-module__body { display: grid; gap: 4px; } .ds-module__title { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-module__title a { color: #111111; text-decoration: none; } .ds-module:hover .ds-module__title a { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 3px; text-decoration-color: #1f3a93; text-underline-offset: 0.14em; } .ds-module__meta { margin: 0; font-size: 12px; color: #3d3a36; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-module__price { margin: 2px 0 0; font-family: 'Unbounded', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; } .ds-module__price s { margin-left: 8px; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-weight: 400; color: #3d3a36; } .ds-module__sizes { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; margin: 4px 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-module__sizes button { min-width: 34px; height: 30px; padding: 0 8px; font: 600 11.5px/1 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; letter-spacing: 0.02em; border: 2px solid #111111; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #111111; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-module__sizes button:hover { background: #111111; color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Fee Ruler
components.description: Real fees and times in tabular Unbounded between 2px ink rules; 2 columns on phones, 4 from 768px.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-ruler { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; border-top: 2px solid #111111; border-bottom: 2px solid #111111; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; } .ds-ruler li { display: grid; gap: 1px; padding: 12px 12px 12px 0; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #3d3a36; } .ds-ruler li + li { border-left: 2px solid #111111; padding-left: 12px; } .ds-ruler strong { font-family: 'Unbounded', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 17px; color: #111111; letter-spacing: -0.01em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; }

components.name: Ledger Rows
components.description: Cart summary as an order slip: Ink Soft label left, Unbounded tabular value right, 2px rules; the total steps up to 20px.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-rows { margin: 0; padding: 0; border-top: 2px solid #111111; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; color: #111111; } .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: baseline; gap: 16px; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 2px solid #111111; } .ds-row dt { font-size: 12.5px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #3d3a36; } .ds-row dd { margin: 0; font-family: 'Unbounded', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; text-align: right; } .ds-row--total dt { color: #111111; font-weight: 600; } .ds-row--total dd { font-size: 20px; }

components.name: Primary Nav
components.description: Unbounded uppercase links; hover and the current page take the 3px indigo underline. The cart button is a 2px ink box with a tabular ink count.
components.html:
• Home
  • New In
  • Shop All
  • Sale
  • Collections

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; background: #fbfbf8; padding: 8px 0; font-family: 'Unbounded', 'Archivo', sans-serif; } .ds-nav ul { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px 28px; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-nav ul a { display: inline-block; padding: 8px 0; font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #111111; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav ul a:hover, .ds-nav ul a[aria-current='page'] { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 3px; text-decoration-color: #1f3a93; text-underline-offset: 0.14em; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; } .ds-nav__sale { font-weight: 700; } .ds-cart { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 10px; border: 2px solid #111111; color: #111111; font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: background 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-cart__count { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; min-width: 22px; height: 22px; padding: 0 6px; background: #111111; color: #ffffff; font: 600 12px/1 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; transition: background 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-cart:hover, .ds-cart:focus-visible { background: #111111; color: #ffffff; } .ds-cart:hover .ds-cart__count { background: #ffffff; color: #111111; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1f3a93; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Phone Tab Bar
components.description: Five cells on a 2px ink rule; the active cell draws a 3px indigo selvedge across its top; the cart cell carries a tabular ink badge.
components.html: HomeShopSale2CartMe
components.css: .ds-tabbar { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr)); width: 390px; height: 62px; background: #fbfbf8; border-top: 2px solid #111111; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; } .ds-tab { position: relative; display: grid; align-content: center; justify-items: center; gap: 4px; color: #111111; text-decoration: none; font: 600 9.5px/1 'Archivo', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-tab.is-active::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -2px; left: 0; right: 0; height: 3px; background: #1f3a93; } .ds-tab__wrap { position: relative; display: inline-block; } .ds-tab__badge { position: absolute; top: -7px; right: -11px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; min-width: 18px; height: 18px; padding: 0 4px; background: #111111; color: #ffffff; font: 600 10.5px/1 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1f3a93; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Status Notice
components.description: Flow notice for cart, checkout and orders. Monochrome tones: Paper box, dashed warning, inverted danger. No thread colour.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-status { display: grid; gap: 14px; max-width: 72ch; margin: 0 0 12px; padding: 16px 18px; border: 2px solid #111111; border-radius: 0; background: #ffffff; color: #111111; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; } .ds-status__body { display: grid; gap: 6px; } .ds-status__title { margin: 0; font-family: 'Unbounded', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-status__message { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; color: #3d3a36; } .ds-status--warning { border-style: dashed; } .ds-status--danger { background: #111111; color: #ffffff; } .ds-status--danger .ds-status__message { color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Order Timeline
components.description: Ink squares joined by 2px lines; done squares fill, the current square thickens and its label takes the indigo underline.
components.html:
1. Placed
  2. Confirmed by phone
  3. Out for delivery
  4. Inspected and paid
components.css: .ds-timeline { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; } .ds-tl { position: relative; display: grid; gap: 8px; justify-items: start; padding-right: 8px; } .ds-tl::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 6px; left: 14px; right: -8px; height: 2px; background: #111111; } .ds-tl:last-child::before { display: none; } .ds-tl__mark { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: block; width: 14px; height: 14px; border: 2px solid #111111; background: #fbfbf8; } .ds-tl__label { font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; color: #3d3a36; } .ds-tl.is-completed .ds-tl__mark { background: #111111; } .ds-tl.is-completed .ds-tl__label { color: #111111; } .ds-tl.is-current .ds-tl__mark { border-width: 3px; } .ds-tl.is-current .ds-tl__label { color: #111111; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 3px; text-decoration-color: #1f3a93; text-underline-offset: 0.14em; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; }

components.name: Empty State
components.description: A 2px dashed ink box with one heading and one sentence; never placeholder products.
components.html:
Nothing here yet

Your cart is empty. Every piece in the shop is delivered in 1-3 days in Addis; you inspect it before you pay.

Shop all
components.css: .ds-empty { display: grid; gap: 12px; justify-items: start; max-width: 560px; padding: 26px 22px; border: 2px dashed #111111; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; color: #111111; } .ds-empty h3 { margin: 0; font-family: 'Unbounded', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-empty p { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.5; color: #3d3a36; max-width: 46ch; } .ds-empty__btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; font-family: 'Unbounded', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 11.5px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; border: 2px solid #111111; background: #111111; color: #ffffff; text-decoration: none; transition: background 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-empty__btn:hover, .ds-empty__btn:focus-visible { background: #ffffff; color: #111111; }

components.name: Indigo Thread Underline
components.description: The one emphasis and link device: a 3px indigo underline under ink text; hover turns it ink.
components.html: Order it. We call. The driver waits while you look it over — then you pay. Read the delivery & returns page.
components.css: .ds-truth { margin: 0; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; color: #3d3a36; max-width: 34ch; } .ds-thread, .ds-link { background: transparent; color: #111111; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 3px; text-decoration-color: #1f3a93; text-underline-offset: 0.14em; text-decoration-skip-ink: none; } .ds-link:hover { text-decoration-color: #111111; }

components.name: Thin Woven Band
components.description: Header close and section divider: the 24x12 thread-line tile repeated at 10px height, in ink, indigo and green only.
components.css: .ds-band { display: block; width: 100%; height: 10px; background-repeat: repeat-x; background-position: left center; background-size: auto 100%; background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%27http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%27%20viewBox%3D%270%200%2024%2012%27%20width%3D%2724%27%20height%3D%2712%27%3E%3Crect%20x%3D%270%27%20y%3D%270%27%20width%3D%2724%27%20height%3D%271.5%27%20fill%3D%27%23111111%27%2F%3E%3Crect%20x%3D%271%27%20y%3D%274%27%20width%3D%2710%27%20height%3D%274%27%20fill%3D%27%231f3a93%27%2F%3E%3Crect%20x%3D%2713%27%20y%3D%274%27%20width%3D%2710%27%20height%3D%274%27%20fill%3D%27%231b7f4c%27%2F%3E%3Crect%20x%3D%270%27%20y%3D%2710.5%27%20width%3D%2724%27%20height%3D%271.5%27%20fill%3D%27%23111111%27%2F%3E%3C%2Fsvg%3E"); }

narrative.overview:
Every storefront page is a length of white cotton with one dense woven border. The tibeb (the patterned band on Ethiopian cotton dress) is the only ornament and the only structure: a thin woven line closes the header on every page (the homepage swaps it for its full hero band), a full band opens the footer, and everything between is ink on cotton: black type, 2px black rules, black-framed photos, black buttons. The two thread colours, indigo and green, live inside the woven tiles with ink; indigo alone leaves the weave, and only ever as a line. Depth is physical (things overlap) and drawn (2px rules); nothing casts a shadow, nothing is rounded, nothing is tinted.

The system is the whole storefront. zent-tibeb.css carries tokens, type, shell and components on body.zh-body; zent-tibeb-bands.css carries the generated tiles; zent-tibeb-pages.css carries catalog, product, commerce and account layouts; zent-home.css carries the homepage hero and sections. All classes use the .zh- prefix (a few legacy hooks keep zent-: search suggestions, alerts, toast, the drawer wrapper). The Control Room dashboard (zent-core.css, zent-dashboard.css) is a separate world and is out of scope. The pop-art halftone black-and-white circular logo is the binding identity asset; the palette is chosen to sit under it, and PRODUCT.md's binding commitment (no red, no yellow anywhere on the storefront) is what removed the earlier red and gold threads.

Density is confident-sparse: a small catalogue shown as a few large modules on a ruled grid, never padded to fill; lists are rows separated by rules, never boxed cards; forms are ruled slips. Amharic swaps both type stacks to Noto Sans Ethiopic with more leading and no negative tracking; palette and rules are unchanged. Product photos in the local fixture are placeholder jewellery; the brand's imagery is supplier photography on plain backgrounds and is not described by this system.
keyCharacteristics: Cotton-white ground with ink type; the two thread colours appear as SVG fills inside the woven tiles, and indigo alone appears outside them, as a 3px or 6px line.
One woven band motif, authored as SVG geometry (120x64 full, 24x12 thin) and tiled as CSS backgrounds in three tints: default (ink lead), indigo, green.
Depth by overlap and 2px ink rules only; no box-shadow, no gradient, no blur, no radius anywhere on the storefront.
Tabular lining numerals on every price, fee, count, size, quantity, order number and time; money is set in Unbounded 600.
Buttons are ink bars in Unbounded; the primary carries a 6px indigo bottom edge (the selvedge).
State is inversion (ink to white, white to ink) or a border thickening from 2px to 3px; danger is inverted ink, warning is a dashed ink frame, success a 3px ink frame.
One motion moment: the homepage hero band clip-paths in left to right once, under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

rules.name: The Thread Stays in the Weave Rule
rules.body: Indigo and green exist as SVG fills inside the band tiles. Outside the tiles only indigo is allowed, and only as a line: the 3px underline, the 6px selvedge, the 3px active tab rule, the focus outline, the selection ground. Green never leaves the tiles. No thread colour is ever text, a background area, or a border around a box.

rules.name: The No Red, No Yellow Rule
rules.body: The storefront carries no red and no yellow in any form: not in tiles, not in alerts, not in error text, not in sale flags. Danger inverts to ink on white; sale and sold-out flags invert to ink; form errors are ink 600 with the indigo underline.

rules.name: The Two-Ink Rule
rules.body: Text is either Ink or Ink Soft. There is no third grey, no tinted text, no coloured link. Links are distinguished by weight (500 or 600) and the indigo underline, not by hue.

rules.name: The Tabular Truth Rule
rules.body: Every price, fee, total, count, size, quantity, order number and time carries font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums (.zh-num, or baked into the price, ruler, ledger and table-number styles). Money and commitments are set in Unbounded 600 so they align and read as facts, not footnotes.

rules.name: The Indigo Underline Rule
rules.body: Emphasis and links use one device: a 3px indigo underline, offset 0.14em (0.12em under row names), text-decoration-skip-ink: none. No bold-only emphasis, no coloured text, no italics. On hover the underline turns ink; on a hovered product module it appears under the title.

rules.name: The Loud Face Rule
rules.body: Unbounded is for what the shopper acts on or is promised: headings, money, nav, buttons, step numerals, order numbers. Reading copy, titles of products and lines, labels and meta stay in Archivo.

rules.name: The Overlap Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: If two things need to read as layered, one overlaps the other and both keep a 2px ink edge. box-shadow, filter: blur and gradients do not appear in this system, at rest or on hover.

rules.name: The Ink Scrim Rule
rules.body: Anything that dims the page (drawer, lightbox) is ink at 0.72 or 0.94 opacity; no colour, no blur, no radius on what sits above it.

dos: Do build every storefront page on body.zh-body with the .zh- prefix: shell and components from zent-tibeb.css, page layout in zent-tibeb-pages.css; keep the Control Room on its own stylesheets.
Do close the header with the thin band and open the footer with the full band on every page; vary a section with the --indigo or --green tint, never with a new colour.
Do set every number a shopper acts on (price, fee, total, count, size, quantity, order number, days, hours) in tabular lining figures, and set money and commitments in Unbounded 600.
Do emphasise and link with the 3px indigo underline; mark the primary action with the 6px indigo selvedge; mark the current nav item, tab and timeline step with indigo as a line.
Do show state by inverting ink and Paper or by thickening a 2px border to 3px; show danger as inverted ink, warning as a dashed ink frame, success as a 3px ink frame.
Do separate rows with 2px ink rules and frame photos, inputs, chips and buttons with 2px ink borders; layer by overlap.
Do keep the radio-chip pattern accessible: the input stays in the DOM, visually hidden, and drives label.zh-chip through :checked and :focus-visible.
Do keep the empty state honest: the dashed ink box with one sentence, never placeholder products, testimonials or metrics.
donts: Don't use box-shadow, gradients, blur or any border-radius; every corner is 0px and the only radius is the 2px focus outline.
Don't use red or yellow anywhere on the storefront: not for errors, sale flags, alerts, badges or tiles.
Don't use indigo as text, a fill area or a box border; it is a line (3px underline, 6px selvedge, 3px tab rule, focus outline) or the selection ground. Don't use green outside the band tiles at all.
Don't introduce a third text colour; text is Ink or Ink Soft, and links differ by weight and underline, not hue.
Don't box content into cards or boxed sidebars; the filter column, the summary and the account panels are ruled, not framed.
Don't set reading copy, product titles or labels in Unbounded, and don't set headings, money or buttons in Archivo.
Don't describe the fixture's placeholder photographs or the legacy asset/images/banner.webp as the brand's imagery; the band and the products carry every viewport.
